body.statement: Fix \(\eta<1/2\), \(\bar H>0\), \(\bar T>0\), and the contact and fixed-interior Gaussian-witness compatibility regimes. There are constants \(c_{\mathrm{ct}}>0\) and \(c_{\mathrm{int}}>0\), depending only on \(\eta,\bar H,\bar T,a_{\mathrm{int}}\) and the fixed class constants, with the following properties. For every \((D_n)\in\mathfrak D_{\eta}^{\mathrm{ct}}\), there exists \(N_{\mathrm{ct}}(D)<\infty\) such that, for every \(n\geq N_{\mathrm{ct}}(D)\) with \(\sqrt n\geq2\bar H\), \[\sup_{h\in[0,\bar H]}E_{P_{n,h}}\!\left[d_{\to}(D_n,\Theta_I(P_{n,h}))\right]\geq c_{\mathrm{ct}}n^{-1/4}.\] For every \((D_n)\in\mathfrak D_{\eta}^{\mathrm{int}}(a_{\mathrm{int}},\bar T)\), there exists \(N_{\mathrm{int}}(D)<\infty\) such that, for every \(n\geq N_{\mathrm{int}}(D)\) satisfying \(\bar T/\sqrt n\leq\min\{a_{\mathrm{int}}/2,(1-a_{\mathrm{int}})/2\}\) and \(2a_{\mathrm{int}}\bar T/\sqrt n+\bar T^2/n\leq1-a_{\mathrm{int}}^2-\delta_0\), \[\sup_{t\in[-\bar T,\bar T]}E_{P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}}\!\left[d_{\to}(D_n,\Theta_I(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}))\right]\geq c_{\mathrm{int}}n^{-1/2}.\] The interior witness-membership theorem gives \(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{int}}(\delta_0)\) throughout this quantified regime. Together with the conditional multiplier-hull upper theorem, these inequalities give matched \(n^{-1/4}\) contact and \(n^{-1/2}\) interior frontiers under the same outer directed-loss convention.
body.justification: The Gaussian testing converses show that the proved fourth-root contact risk is information-theoretic and that the same hull attains the root-\(n\) interior frontier.
body.gap: Generic nonregularity results do not furnish these explicit leaky-instrument directed-Hausdorff lower bounds.
body.consumer: Method developers obtain certified contact and interior benchmarks; because the witnesses lie in the broader published model, the converse transfers upward.
